name: IndiGo

snapshot.about: India's leading airline providing domestic and international air travel services.

narrative: Q1 FY27 unit passenger revenue beat mid-teens guidance with 19.9% growth, and Q1 FY27 capacity met guidance at 3%. However, Q3 FY26 capacity grew 11%, missing high-teens guidance, and full-year FY26 recorded a net loss of 23.9 billion rupees.

said.quote: With these increases in capacity, we estimate early teens capacity growth for the full financial year 2026 which is slightly higher than our earlier communicated early double-digit guidance of capacity growth

actual_source.quote: We added capacity in an optimized manner and grew by around 3 percent in terms of seats deployed and around 8 percent in terms of ASKs

promises.note: Capacity growth of 8% in Q2, 11% in Q3, and guided 10% in Q4 fell short of early teens.

bull.point: Unit passenger revenue in Q1 FY27 increased 19.9% year-over-year, surpassing the guided mid-teens improvement.

bull.point: Free cash balance reached ₹36,940 crore at the end of Q3 FY26, maintaining robust liquidity buffers.
